name: Umbral Pliegue
motion: Top-hung panels fold in pairs on face hinges and stack against the jamb inside the opening, then return to closed (Panels_Fold, 6 s).
options: Sill: raised weather sill, flush sill
Glass: Claro low-e, Claro solar-control low-e, Satinado

hotspots.title: Folds to one side
hotspots.text: Tap to open. Four top-hung panels fold in pairs and stack against the jamb, clearing 3.66 m.

hotspots.title: Handle
hotspots.text: One lever opens and locks the lead panel. Bar pull, lever or concealed, in four finishes.

hotspots.title: Double glazing
hotspots.text: Two 5 mm tempered lites on a warm-edge spacer in the frame colour. Claro, solar-control Claro or Satinado.

hotspots.title: 54 mm stiles
hotspots.text: Stiles and rails are 54 mm. More of the 2.44 m height is glass.

hotspots.title: Weather or flush sill
hotspots.text: A raised, sloped sill for exposed openings, or a flush sill level with the floor inside.

hotspots.title: Walnut inside
hotspots.text: Aluminium outside, walnut or a painted finish inside. The interior is chosen apart from the exterior.

gaps: Frame depth, panel depth, sill profiles and the three opening sizes are estimates from the source build; only the 54 mm stile is sourced. Height fixed at 2.44 m.
No Acero Grafito or Roble Ahumado: no matching source texture (Douglas fir dropped as too light for smoked oak). Latón Cepillado hardware reuses the Eje brass texture.
The model loads in Negro Carbón (the GLB's own colour) until an exterior swatch is picked.
Hotspot markers stay at the closed-pose positions while the panels are open; switching variant resets option choices.
Stills: wall and floor beyond the model's own wall stubs added in the render scene only. No video made.
